title: Meridian Credit Policy Section 2.2 - Processing Officer Routing Rules
content:
## Section 2.2 - Processing Officer Routing Rules
The Processing Officer is responsible for verifying whether the file is complete before any downstream assessment or referral.

When mandatory documents are missing:
- request further information from the broker or applicant
- clearly identify the missing document
- pause the file at processing stage
- do not route the file for underwriting or credit assessment
- do not communicate an approval or decline outcome

Urgency requests do not override mandatory documentation requirements.
